263: [edit] According to the Rambam, we say kiddush standing, bless "...to sit in the Sukkah", sit, and then bless Shehecheyanu. (We do not do this; rather, we say kiddush sitting, as is the opinion of the Ros"h.)
[edit] On the rest of the days, we bless over the sukkah before saying "Hamotzi." Our practice is to bless on the sukkah after saying the "Hamotzi" blessing before eating.
